scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了。我應該先減輕背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Have you tried to buy some contraband items with Rock Ridge Coins? I can make your contraband items better.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
你試過用洛克裡奇硬幣購買違禁品嗎？我可以幫你強化違禁品。

scripts.text: Make them better? How?
scripts.translation: 強化？怎麼做？

scripts.text: Enchant contraband items.
scripts.translation: 強化違禁品

scripts.text: Reset contraband item Enchantment level.
scripts.translation: 重置違禁品強化等級

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Ah, have we met before? I meet so many people every day that I can't remember all of their faces. Let me catch you up to speed.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
啊，我們以前見過嗎？我每天見到很多人，記不住所有人的臉。讓我給你講講情況。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
I can enchant the equipment that you can buy with Rock Ridge Coins, for up to 3 sockets for Armor and Garments and up to 2 sockets for Accessories.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
我可以強化你用洛克裡奇硬幣購買的裝備，防具和服裝最多可強化3個插槽，飾品最多可強化2個插槽。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
I charge 2 Rock Ridge Coins per socket for both enchanting and resetting.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
無論是強化還是重置，每個插槽收費2枚洛克裡奇硬幣。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Oh, and note that these contraband items are prone to destruction, especially when they are reset.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
哦，另外請注意，這些違禁品很容易損壞，尤其是在重置的時候。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Garment
scripts.translation: 服裝

scripts.text: Accessory (Right Slot)
scripts.translation: 飾品（右側插槽）

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
你真傻。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Why are you wasting my time? Go wear your equipment first.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
你為什麼要浪費我的時間？先去穿戴你的裝備吧。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
I don't handle items like this.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
我不處理這種物品。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Something wrong happened.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
發生了一些錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
It's not enchanted. What do you expect me to reset?
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
它沒有強化過。你想讓我重置什麼？

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Oh, do you really want to reset it? As I told you before, contraband Vigilante Badges are prone to destruction.
[Contraband Processor]
Alright, come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
哦，你真的要重置它嗎？我剛才說過，違禁品巡衛隊徽章很容易損壞。
[違禁品處理員]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Oh, do you really want to reset it? As I told you before, contraband Vigilante Badges are prone to destruction.
[Contraband Processor]
I charge 2 Rock Ridge Coins for this service. Bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
哦，你真的要重置它嗎？我剛才說過，違禁品巡衛隊徽章很容易損壞。
[違禁品處理員]
這項服務收費2枚洛克裡奇硬幣。請把它們帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Oh, do you really want to reset it? As I told you before, contraband Vigilante Badges are prone to destruction.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
哦，你真的要重置它嗎？我剛才說過，違禁品巡衛隊徽章很容易損壞。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Oh, do you really want to reset it? As I told you before, contraband Vigilante Badges are prone to destruction.
[Contraband Processor]
Ah, that didn't turn out well.
Well, just my luck.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
哦，你真的要重置它嗎？我剛才說過，違禁品巡衛隊徽章很容易損壞。
[違禁品處理員]
啊，結果不太理想。
真是倒霉。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Oh, do you really want to reset it? As I told you before, contraband Vigilante Badges are prone to destruction.
[Contraband Processor]
Done. Check it out.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
哦，你真的要重置它嗎？我剛才說過，違禁品巡衛隊徽章很容易損壞。
[違禁品處理員]
完成了。看看效果吧。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text: Let's do it.
scripts.translation: 就這麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
This has been enchanted to the maximum limit. Maybe you should reset it.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
這件裝備已經強化到極限了。也許你應該重置它。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
This has been enchanted to the maximum limit. Maybe you should reset it.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
這件裝備已經強化到極限了。也許你應該重置它。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Did you just try to switch equipment?
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
你剛才試圖切換裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
I charge 2 Rock Ridge Coins for this service. Bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
這項服務收費2枚洛克裡奇硬幣。請把它們帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Ah, that didn't turn out well.
Well, just my luck.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
啊，結果不太理想。
真是倒霉。

scripts.text:
[Contraband Processor]
Done. Check it out.
scripts.translation:
[違禁品處理員]
完成了。看看效果吧。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
You must be really strong to carry so much with you.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
你能攜帶這麼多東西，一定很強壯吧。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
If you want to lighten your bag, there's a Kafra employee in the direction of the sheriff's office.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
如果你想減輕背包負擔，在警長辦公室的方向有一位卡普拉 職員。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
You're an adventurer. I like people like you who have passion.
So, are you here because of ^0000CDit^000000?
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
你是一名冒險者。我喜歡像你這樣充滿熱情的人。
那麼，你是因為^0000CD它^000000而來的嗎？

scripts.text: Because of what?
scripts.translation: 因為什麼？

scripts.text: I am.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Hmpf, don't act like you don't know. I'm talking about the special equipment you can buy in Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
哼，別裝作不知道。我說的是在洛克理奇可以購買的特殊裝備。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
The armor dealer brings in new stock every Friday, and it's sold almost as soon as it's in, every time.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
防具商人每週五都會進新貨，而且每次都會很快售罄。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
*Chuckle* Which one do you want: one for your ^0000CDshoulders^000000, ^0000CDneck, or chest^000000?
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
*輕笑* 你想要哪一種：^0000CD肩部^000000、^0000CD頸部還是胸部^000000的？

scripts.text: Um, anything.
scripts.translation: 嗯，隨便哪個。

scripts.text: For my shoulders
scripts.translation: 肩部的

scripts.text: For my neck or chest
scripts.translation: 頸部或胸部的

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
*Chuckle* Sure, young people always look good, no matter what they wear.
But if you want something special, go check the armor shop.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
*輕笑* 當然，年輕人穿什麼都好看。
但如果你想要特別的東西，去防具店看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Pick one you like, and I'll tell you about it.
All the equipment is ^0000CD3,000,000 Zeny^000000 regardless of its type.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
選一個你喜歡的，我來告訴你詳情。
所有裝備的價格都是^0000CD3,000,000 Zeny^000000，不分型別。

scripts.text: Elemental Cape
scripts.translation: 元素斗篷

scripts.text: Golden Scarf
scripts.translation: 黃金圍巾

scripts.text: Mine Worker Backpack
scripts.translation: 礦工背包

scripts.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Pick one you like, and I'll tell you about it.
All the equipment is ^0000CD1,500,000 Zeny^000000 regardless of its type.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
選一個你喜歡的，我來告訴你詳情。
所有裝備的價格都是^0000CD1,500,000 Zeny^000000，不分型別。

scripts.text: Vigilante Badge
scripts.translation: 巡衛隊徽章

scripts.text: Hippie Feather
scripts.translation: 嬉皮羽毛手鐲

scripts.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Oops, I guess you're too innocent to hear what I just said.
You should forget it, for your own good.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
哎呀，看來你太單純了，不適合聽我剛才說的話。
為了你好，最好忘掉這件事。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Ah, you're interested in the
[{0}].
Click the name for the detailed description.
As I told you, it's ^0000CD{1} Zeny^000000. Do you want to buy it?
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
啊，你對
[{0}]
感興趣。
點選名稱檢視詳細描述。
正如我告訴你的，價格是^0000CD{1} Zeny^000000。你想買嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Huh. So I wasted my breath on someone who doesn't want to buy.
Each and every piece of this equipment has a story to tell, and it might hold a grudge if you don't take it with you.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
哼。看來我白費口舌了，你根本不想買。
這裡的每一件裝備都有故事，如果你不帶走它，它可能會記恨你。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
I suggest you don't tell anyone else about it,
and promise me you'll be back. I'll keep the equipment for you.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
我建議你不要告訴別人這件事，
並答應我會回來。我會幫你保留這些裝備。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Uh-oh, you don't have enough money to buy this.
Why don't you come back later? I'll always be here.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
哎呀，你的錢不夠買這個。
為什麼不晚點再來呢？我會一直在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
Sure. Here's your {0}.
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
好的。這是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Affable Lady]
People often let their preconceived notions fool them. Most people don't think an old woman like me would sell such special items.
Come back if you want more equipment. I'll always be here. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[和藹的女士]
人們常常被先入為主的觀念所欺騙。大多數人不會認為像我這樣的老婦人會賣這麼特別的物品。
如果你想要更多裝備，歡迎回來。我會一直在這裡。*輕笑*

scripts.text:
[Howard]
Err, you're carrying a lot of things.
Why don't you go
lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
呃，你攜帶的東西太多了。
為什麼不先去減輕一下背包的重量呢？

scripts.text:
[Howard]
Hello. How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
你好。今天有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Howard]
Hm, you don't have the coins.
Why don't you collect them first?
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
嗯，你沒有硬幣。
為什麼不先去收集一些呢？

scripts.text:
[Howard]
Ah, you have the coins.
Thank you for helping Rock Ridge.
Take a look around and see if there's something you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
啊，你有硬幣。
謝謝你幫助洛克理奇。
四處看看，看看有沒有你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Howard]
What would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Howard]
{0}, got it.
That'll be {1} Rock Ridge Coins.
Are you certain you want this item?
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
{0}，明白了。
那是{1}洛克裡奇硬幣。
你確定要買這個物品嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Howard]
If you have made up your mind, then please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
如果你已經決定了，請再和我談談。

scripts.text:
[Howard]
You don't have enough coins.
Please bring more.
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
您的硬幣不足。
請多帶一些。

scripts.text:
[Howard]
There you go. Enjoy!
scripts.translation:
[霍華德]
給您。請享用！

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
You're carrying too much to buy weapons.
Please go lighten your bag first.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
您攜帶的物品太多，無法購買武器。
請先減輕負重。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
I carry shotguns, revolvers, and bullets.
Tell me what kind of item you want, and I'll show you a list.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
我這裡有霰彈槍、左輪手槍和子彈。
請告訴我您想要哪種物品，我會給您看清單。

scripts.text: Shotguns
scripts.translation: 霰彈槍

scripts.text: Revolvers
scripts.translation: 左輪手槍

scripts.text: Bullets
scripts.translation: 子彈

scripts.text: Sell items.
scripts.translation: 出售商品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
You want to browse shotguns? I see.
Let me show you some good models.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
您想看看霰彈槍？好的。
讓我給您展示幾款不錯的型號。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
You want to browse revolvers? I see.
I've just brought in a few good models.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
您想看看左輪手槍？好的。
我剛進了一批不錯的型號。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
You want bullets, I see.
All my bullets are of the finest quality.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
您想要子彈，是嗎。
我這裡的子彈都是最高品質的。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
Sure, if you have things I can sell.
Show me what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
當然，如果您有我可以收購的物品。
請給我看看您有什麼。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Dealer]
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
請再說一遍。

scripts.text:
[Armor Dealer]
You're carrying too much to buy anything.
Please go lighten your bag first.
scripts.translation:
[防具商人]
您攜帶的物品太多，無法購買任何東西。
請先減輕負重。

scripts.text:
[Armor Dealer]
I'm closed today.
Once a week, I close my shop and spend the day being thankful for what I have.
scripts.translation:
[防具商人]
今天休息。
每週有一天，我會關店休息，感謝我所擁有的一切。

scripts.text:
[Armor Dealer]
...And it's the same day that no deliveries come.
scripts.translation:
[防具商人]
...而且那天也沒有貨物送達。

scripts.text:
[Armor Dealer]
Hello. Welcome to the Rock Ridge Armor Shop.
Today,{0}are in stock.
scripts.translation:
[防具商人]
您好。歡迎光臨洛克理奇防具店。
今天，{0}有貨。

scripts.text:
[Armor Dealer]
Armor is bulkier than weapons, so I can only have a set number of products delivered every week.
I'll show you the list of available items. ^0000CDIf it's blank, then everything's sold out^000000.
scripts.translation:
[防具商人]
防具比武器更佔地方，所以我每週只能接收固定數量的貨物。
我會給您看可用物品的清單。^0000CD如果是空的，那就說明全部售罄^000000。

scripts.text:
[Armor Dealer]
And for that same reason, I can't give ^0000CDspecial discounts^000000.
But ^0000CDall my products are hard to find elsewhere^000000. Why don't you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[防具商人]
而且由於同樣的原因，我無法提供^0000CD特別折扣^000000。
但是^0000CD我的商品在其他地方很難買到^000000。您不妨看看？
